answer_1.quote: We propose PATIENT-Ψ, a novel simulated patient agent that integrates cognitive modeling with LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: simulated patient conversations in therapy sessions

answer_2.quote: For evaluating accuracy, we apply two approaches based on the types of the CBT components being assessed: 1. Text-based fields... we generate a multiple-choice question by randomly sampling four additional components from PATIENT-Ψ-CM, alongside the ground-truth component. GPT-4 is then prompted to select the component most closely reflected in PATIENT-Ψ's conversations. We report the accuracy based on a 5-class classification task. 2. Categorization fields... GPT-4 is prompted to choose the options that are reflected in the patient's conversations, and we report the F1 score for these selections.

answer_3.quote: Given the potential of using LLMs for evaluating text generation quality, we attempt to automatically assess the fidelity and accuracy of PATIENT-Ψ and the baseline using two state-of-the-art LLMs as evaluators: GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) and Llama 3 70B (AI@Meta, 2024).

answer_4.quote: We recruit 20 current mental health practitioners and 13 social work students, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Experts compare PATIENT-Ψ and the baseline along dimensions including fidelity, accuracy, and effectiveness using Likert scales and pairwise comparisons. Trainees evaluate perceived skill and confidence improvements.
